name: Memory
source:
A withdrawn young man takes under the alias Sano Mitsunami and attends his older brother’s former school. What answers he is looking for are unclear but he knows something wasn’t right about his brother’s sudden death. Or is there something more he’s looking for and why he did he choose to keep his identity a secret?

[From [url=https://www.deviantart.com/lightshowonks/journal/Memory-Character-Info-420026220]Deviant Art[/url]]
translation:
一名性格孤僻的年轻人以佐野三波的别名，进入哥哥曾就读的学校。他寻找的答案尚不明确，但他知道哥哥突然死亡并不正常。还是说，他在寻找其他东西？又为什么要隐瞒身份？

[译自[url=https://www.deviantart.com/lightshowonks/journal/Memory-Character-Info-420026220]Deviant Art[/url]]
